title: A Digital Presence for Precision Manufacturing and AI Robotics
excerpt: How we built a high-performance, multilingual web platform for Old World Labs, a company operating at the intersection of additive manufacturing, robotics, and Unreal Engine development.
challenge: Old World Labs operates across three highly technical domains: microscale additive manufacturing, AI-driven robotics, and Unreal Engine visualization. The challenge was presenting these distinct service lines under one cohesive digital identity, without diluting any single offering, while speaking credibly to decision-makers in biotech, aerospace, and semiconductor industries.
solution: We developed a dark-mode-first website on Next.js with Three.js-powered interactive visualizations, including a WebGL particle network and animated icon cloud. The site supports 7 languages via middleware-based i18n routing and loads in under one second globally through Vercel's edge network.
